sloka: ततः क्रुद्धो महातेजा इन्द्रजित् समितिञ्जयः।आग्नेयं सन्दधे दीप्तं स लोकं सङ्क्षिपन्निव ।। ६.९१.५७ ।।
transliteration: tataḥ kruddho mahātejā indrajit samitiñjayaḥ।āgneyaṁ sandadhe dīptaṁ sa lokaṁ saṅkṣipanniva ।। 6.91.57 ।।

translations.english: Then the very wonderful weapon of Varuna was made ineffective by the highly energetic Indrajith's who used glowing fire missiles as if to destroy the whole world.
